warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, A-03, A-04 and the elevations/sections. Vector CAD PDF, text drawn as lines — every value read off the rendered page.

Dimension sweep (section 4 rule 4): structural S-01..S-05, architectural A-03 (floor plans), A-04 (roof plan), A-05/A-06 (elevations), A-07/A-08 (sections) and A-09 (stair ST-01). Every printed tick that hangs off a known line became a line, which is why y carries eight primes before B: -1.90 (A-03/A-05 ลานซักล้าง edge), -1.00 (eave), 0.10 / 1.10 / 1.50 (stair A-09, A-03), 1.00 / 2.00 (Truss T1 panels), 1.60 (S-02 upper-floor 0.10 step). A-10, A-11, E-01/E-02 and SN-01..SN-03 were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run.

S-02 upper floor prints 1.50 + 0.10 + 1.40 between A and B while A-03 upper floor prints 1.50 + 1.50: measured on the drawing, the bay 2-3 beam B1(+3.05) is centred at 1.50 (A'''''') and the bay 1-2 beam at 1.60 (A'''''''). Both lines kept; the 0.10 is read as the offset between the two beams, not a beam width.

Truss T1 (S-04) prints its 1.000 x 6 panel chain with no grid bubbles under it; its supports are labelled T3 / T2 / อะเส, which sit on rows C / B / A on S-03, and the 3.00 + 3.00 sub-totals match — so the chain is placed on the y axis running C to A (truss drawn with C on the left). Truss T2/T3 chains are placed on x the same way (T1 at both ends and the middle = grids 1, 2, 3).

z: the sections A-07/A-08 print roof levels +5.86 / +6.33 / +6.70 while the elevations A-05/A-06 print +5.95 / +6.70 and S-03 prints หลังอะเส +5.96 — all printed values kept as separate levels, none reconciled. The beam tops +0.25 / +0.35 / +3.05 come from the S-02 beam marks BX(+X.XX).
A-09 stair elevation prints 1.000 + 2.000 = 3.000 with no grid marker under it — kept as a floating chain with edge ends (the stair plan above it is the one tied to grids 1/2/A).
